breaking_news.headline: As Taiwan expands Arizona chip plant, China warns against developing political ties
breaking_news.summary: The world's biggest chipmaker now manufactures at scale in Phoenix, as well as Taiwan. China is warning political leaders in Arizona to not get too friendly.

breaking_news.headline: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
breaking_news.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

breaking_news.headline: Here's the latest sticker shock: Borrowing for a mortgage -- or a car
breaking_news.summary: It's not just mortgages being at their highest level in almost three years — but the cost of loans for cars and higher education are among the borrowing costs affected, too.

breaking_news.headline: Who will win the 2026 Nobel Prize in economics?
breaking_news.summary: A thinly traded prediction market offers a starting point. We explore potential winners and the big ideas that could earn them economics' biggest prize.

breaking_news.headline: Why Trump just loosened the rules on 'dyed diesel' — normally a farm fuel
breaking_news.summary: Trump is temporarily allowing this fuel to be used on highways, although it's typically just for off-road farm and construction vehicles. Could that lower the price of diesel?

breaking_news.headline: As crypto and prediction markets expand, their regulator shrinks
breaking_news.summary: Even as the agency is tasked with drawing up new rules for crypto and prediction markets, its staffing and enforcement actions have dropped precipitously during the second Trump administration.

breaking_news.headline: OpenAI caught Russians and Iranians using ChatGPT for influence campaigns
breaking_news.summary: The company says Russian operatives used its AI chatbot to update their bosses, shedding light on influence campaigns previously not attributed to Russia.

breaking_news.headline: Why American investors love European defense startups
breaking_news.summary: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.

breaking_news.headline: Crazy Rich Asians to return as TV show with original film's stars
breaking_news.summary: The show will pick up after the hit 2018 film, and will also star Michelle Yeoh and Ronny Chieng.

breaking_news.headline: ICE agent shoots man in New York City
breaking_news.summary: The mayor of New York expressed outrage at the shooting which the Department of Homeland Security said happened during the arrest of a "criminal illegal alien".

breaking_news.headline: Two Renoir paintings stolen from French museum are recovered
breaking_news.summary: The two works were seized last month when thieves cut through a fence and smashed a window at the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera.

breaking_news.headline: Thieves steal 30,000 wine bottles worth €5m in Italy, reports say
breaking_news.summary: The heist at the Florence-based winery is believed to be one of the largest thefts of its kind in Italy.

breaking_news.headline: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
breaking_news.summary: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

breaking_news.headline: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
breaking_news.summary: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

breaking_news.headline: Fort Hood survivor supports gunman's execution by firing squad but questions livestream
breaking_news.summary: Alonzo Lunsford tells the BBC the punishment befits the crime but he has some doubts whether the public should be able to watch it.

breaking_news.headline: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
breaking_news.summary: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia-backed data centre firm scraps IPO as AI valuation concerns deepen
breaking_news.summary: Firmus said it had made the decision due to "recent market volatility and prevailing market conditions".

breaking_news.headline: 'You cannot build this car anywhere else in the world'
breaking_news.summary: Car maker Longbow, which hopes to build thousands of cars, says the region has the talent and know-how.

breaking_news.headline: Why are more roofs not made of solar tiles?
breaking_news.summary: Solar tiles were touted as an attractive alternative to solar panels - why have they not taken off?

breaking_news.headline: Mark Zuckerberg has an image problem - so why is Meta's business booming?
breaking_news.summary: A new film paints the Meta founder as a villain. But the tech firm seems immune to bad publicity, writes our North America tech correspondent.
